summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery data locals in scan artifacts

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic local variable 'data' to stage-accurate names in each of the six functions of src/koru/scan_artifacts.py that mutate it: report (_scan_jscpd_report, parsed jscpd duplication report), redup_payload (_scan_redup_filtered and _scan_redup_changed, each a decoded redup duplicate-group export), artifact (_scan_structured_semcod_report and _scan_pfix_report, each a _load_structured_artifact result), plans_payload (_scan_todo2code_plans, decoded todo2code plans document). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'data' group drops from 6 scopes to 0. Each new name lands at <= 2 scopes, so no (file, variable) group grows toward the threshold. Pure rename of function-internal locals; the generic 'data' parameters of the pure helpers _sum_structured_counts / _count_pfix_diagnose_issues are not mutating scopes and keep their names; no behavior change. The separate pre-existing shotgun findings in this file (path, rel, found, payload, files, suggestions, priority, text) are untouched by design.
nonGoals: No behavior, signal, suggestion-shape or interface change
No restructuring into a shared artifact-loader abstraction (each local already names one artifact stage; the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction)
No rename of the pure helpers' generic 'data' parameters or of locals in other files
No fix for the separate pre-existing shotgun findings in this file (path, rel, found, payload, files, suggestions, priority, text) - minimal scope for this ticket's reported smell only

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local renames only, inside one module. Every function that decodes an artifact names it after the stage it serves (jscpd report, redup export, structured artifact, todo2code plans document); the generic name 'data' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm ProjectAnalyzer on the src/koru package plus mutation grouping: baseline reports 'Mutation of variable data spans 6 functions' from exactly the ticket's six scopes; after the rename the 'data' group is empty, the file's mutation count is unchanged (247) and every other pre-existing finding is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named data again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone code2llm ProjectAnalyzer.analyze_project(<repo>/src/koru) + per-variable mutation-scope grouping, original vs renamed content of src/koru/scan_artifacts.py>"
validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm analyzer on the package directory (single-file analysis yields empty function scopes and silently misses smells, so the package dir is required). Baseline content reports a 'data' mutation group of 6 scopes (_scan_jscpd_report, _scan_pfix_report, _scan_redup_changed, _scan_redup_filtered, _scan_structured_semcod_report, _scan_todo2code_plans) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 6 functions'. Renamed content reports a 'data' group of 0 scopes; file mutation count unchanged at 247 (pure rename); no new (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold; renamed locals land at <= 2 scopes each. The separate pre-existing findings are unchanged by design.

The three suites covering src/koru/scan_artifacts.py pass unchanged (pure rename of function-internal locals; the suites exercise the jscpd, redup, structured-report, pfix and todo2code scans through the public scan entry points) and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
